q0AnchorReason: Evaluates at the PROTON pin. q0 enters through q_parameter.Q_50_DIGIT_STR, which resolves to the proton anchor (1.1099785827513808075...) because this stem is not listed under ideal_muon; proton is the standing default for compute per the 2026-08-07 owner directive. The stem IS declared physical_proton in computations/q0_anchor_manifest.json, and that declaration cannot stamp this witness: the manifest is read inside WitnessBuilder.build(), and this producer hand-rolls its witness and never enters build(). Hence the declaration here, which is the only route that reaches the file.
name: logratio-exactly-pairwise-additive
description: S_on/S_off equals the product of chain bond factors at every composition of A=3 and A=4 to 1.8e-50, so the log-ratio channel is exactly pairwise-additive with identically zero many-body terms.
scope: (a) measurement at A=3,4; additivity is not proved in general. Nothing fitted, nothing wired, no AME comparison computed here.

assertions.name: S_on/S_off is exactly the product of chain bond factors at every composition
assertions.detail: worst relative deviation across all 9 compositions of A=[3, 4]: 1.77826e-50. Taking logs, L = sum over chain bonds of (-log f_bond) with NO three-body term at A=3 and NO four-body term at A=4.

assertions.name: the search space for the shortfall is narrowed to bond values and bond count
assertions.detail: Stated as a consequence of the measured additivity, not as a new measurement. It removes one candidate class (irreducible many-body terms in L) rather than supplying the missing binding.

assertions.name: the tension with t7qv is stated with a proposed mechanism, explicitly unverified
assertions.detail: Two measurements that look contradictory are reported side by side with the candidate reconciliation labelled as a reading of their commit message. Asserting it as established would be a claim about code this probe never ran.

assertions.name: the f_pn mismatch is explained as the colour arm, not silently absorbed
assertions.detail: relative difference 0.000141475, consistent with the ~1e-4 arm gap measured in #6379. Reported rather than papered over — a 5th-digit disagreement with a canonical constant is exactly the kind of thing that should be chased, not rounded away.
